Incident Description The Sinlahekin Fire is a wildfire burning 12 miles West of Tonasket, WA that was started from a lightning strike in the afternoon on July 26th, 2026. The fire is burning in steep, rocky, forested terrain with limited access from the roadway. Fire activity showed significant growth within the first 24 hours from wind driven and uphill runs. NE Type 3 IMT1 took command of the incident on the afternoon of July 27th and are working with incoming resources to contain the fire.
